title: The Villainous Vape: Advancing Vaping Prevention Among Adolescents Through a Comic Book
official: The Villainous Vape: Advancing Vaping Prevention Among Adolescents Through a Comic Book
summary: This is a randomized controlled trial to assess the feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary impact of The Villainous Vape, a vaping prevention comic book, among adolescents.

interventions.name: Mind Matters: The Body's Response to Nicotine, Tobacco, and Vaping

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Know how to read and speak English and/or Spanish
* Be at least 12 but no greater than 17 years old
* Be willing to complete three study visits over Zoom or a phone call
* Live in Orleans County, New York

Exclusion Criteria:

* A household member participating in the study
* Living outside of Orleans County, New York
